coastal.title: 80-year-old cyclist dies in Chilliwack hit and run
coastal.description: An 80-year-old woman has died after she was struck by a car while on a bicycle in Chilliwack, B.C., Saturday evening.

kamloops.title: B.C. family rescues exhausted baby bear swimming in Okanagan Lake
kamloops.description: Christina Zamniuk says they were boating between their Vernon lakehouse and Adventure Bay last weekend when a baby bear was spotted swimming in the middle of the lake.

kamloops.title: New and old Canadian-based players highlight NHLers in different homes this season
kamloops.description: The NHL off-season saw significant names switch teams while a veteran head coach, Mike Babcock, is back in the spotlight.

northwest.title: Acclaimed artist Takao Tanabe's 100th birthday honoured with 60-year retrospective
northwest.description: Over his career the prolific Prince Rupert-born artist has created hundreds of artworks in a wide array of artistic styles. Curators at the Audain Art Museum say they're doing everything they can to ensure Tanabe's legacy will be remembered and celebrated.

southeast.title: Skunk rabies case prompts public warning in B.C. Interior
southeast.description: Health officials in B.C. are warning people in the Kooteney Lake region to avoid contact with skunks after one animal recently tested positive for rabies.
